t: What Measurement Uncertainty Database Is All About
title: What Measurement Uncertainty Database Is All About
description: Every measurement has uncertainty: a reported value without it is incomplete. The GUM (Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement, 1993) is the world standard: Type A uncertainties come from statistics of repeats, Type B from calibration certificates and judgment. Uncertainties combine by root-sum-of-squares when independent, and results are reported as value ± expanded uncertainty with coverage factor k (k=2 ≈ 95% confidence). This database is the complete uncertainty method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Measurement Uncertainty Database: a complete reference database of full uncertainty method records.
key_points: What this database holds: full uncertainty method records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
